paragraphs: The Range Rover Velar P340 is a current model in the Velar range, part of the L560 generation that has been in production since 2017. It uses the Ingenium AJ300P, a 3.0-litre six-cylinder petrol engine. The Ingenium petrol family is generally considered more reliable than its diesel counterparts in Land Rover's lineup, with any issues typically limited to cooling system components over time. cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the Range Rover Velar P340 from 2023 to present. The Ingenium AJ300P features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older Ingenium AJ300P V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every Ingenium AJ300P rebuild.
